description: This file contains implementation of netlink message handlers and callback management functions for a networking library, including functions for allocating, cloning, setting callbacks, and error handling.

methods.name: nl_cb_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new callback handle with a specified kind.

methods.name: nl_cb_clone
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of an existing callback handle.

methods.name: nl_cb_put
methods.description: Decrements reference count and frees callback handle if no longer used.

methods.name: nl_cb_set
methods.description: Sets a callback function for a specific message type and kind.

methods.name: nl_cb_err
methods.description: Sets an error callback function for a specified callback handle.
